turns.text: Hi, yes, um, I need to change a flight. Actually two flights, well, two bookings. My name is Elena Popova.
Hello, this is Skyline Air flight changes. I can help with that. To verify you, please give me the booking code and last name for the first booking.
It's AA1D5V, Popova. And the second one is AB2D6W, that one's under Ivanov, my friend.
Thank you, Ms. Popova. I have both bookings verified now. What change would you like to make?
Okay, I want to move to the 14:30, SK212, to London. Both of us, both bookings. Is that possible?

SK212 leaves Dubai at 14:30 on Thursday, but it has only two Economy seats left. A voluntary change on Economy costs a $75 fee plus the $45 fare difference, so $120 for each booking, unless the booking was made within the last 24 hours, in which case it is free.
A hundred and twenty each? Hm. Okay. Can you check the fee for Ivanov's one, the AB2D6W?
I can look at that booking under the Ivanov name you gave me. I can't discuss the other passenger's details beyond the change itself. Would you like me to go ahead with your booking, AA1D5V, first?
Yeah, do mine first. Hurry, I'm in a taxi.
I will change AA1D5V from SK210 to SK212 on Thursday at 14:30, for a total of $120. Do you confirm?
Um, yes. Wait, hold on, are there two seats? Because Ivanov is on his own booking, so would both of us fit?
SK212 shows two Economy seats left, which covers both bookings if both are moved now. I can't hold a seat, so it is one change for both or neither.
Ok, neither then. I'll think about it. Bye.
Understood. Nothing has been changed, and both bookings stay on SK210 on Thursday at 08:10. Thank you for calling Skyline Air.
